bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
owner="$(cat "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt")"
[[ "$owner" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{3,18}$ ]] || exit 61
x="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT CASE WHEN step='preview' AND data->>'text' IN ('Rich編集の安全テスト','個別編集済みの安全テスト') AND NOT data ? 'shareCode' THEN 'SAFE_TEST_DRAFT' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM public_post_drafts WHERE owner_user_id=$owner AND module='link';" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 62
test "$x" = SAFE_TEST_DRAFT || exit 63
echo ONLY_USERBOT_TEST_DRAFT=PASS
